name: Before Evolution
summary:
What started as two friends messing around in VR turned into something way bigger than either of them expected. DB and Enzo first met online through their shared love of Gorilla Tag and quickly realized they both had a passion for creating—not just playing. After hours spent hopping between games, talking ideas, and pushing each other to learn Unity, they decided to try building their own world from the ground up.
